name: Privatzimmer Margarete
beschreibung: The Privatzimmer Margarete is located in the quiet Thiersee-Tal in Kaiserwinkl, nestled in the mountain landscape of Tirol. The inn offers a traditional atmosphere with cozy rooms and regional cuisine. Guests appreciate the closeness to nature and the opportunity to explore the surroundings on walks and hikes. The accommodation is suitable for travelers seeking relaxation in a smaller setting.
